repos_data.description: Offline desktop image annotation tool (PyQt6): bbox, polygon, OBB, keypoints, brush masks, semantic & panoptic segmentation. Exports YOLO (detect/seg/OBB/pose), COCO (instances/RLE/keypoints/panoptic), Pascal VOC, LabelMe, semantic masks.

Image Annotation, including Histopathology slides; From H&E slide to training data in one conversation: nuclei, outlines and slide QC, exported to QuPath, COCO or YOLO. No GPU needed. For Whole Slide Imaging (WSI), Digital and Computational Pathology, Bioinformatics, Tumor Microenvironment (TME) and MLOps Data Labeling.
